title: Markdown — page container with CRUD tabs + diagrams
description: Markdown (.md) page container with optional CRUD surfaces — Read (rich text), Write (source editor + live preview), Review (block-anchored comments). Renders mermaid diagrams + recharts charts from fenced blocks. Same markdown grammar as the notion block editor (blocksToMarkdown bridge), so notion-exported content renders identically. Self-contained parser + inline renderer.

axes.description: read = single read-only surface; crud = Read/Write/Review tabs
basic = text doc; rich = mermaid diagram + recharts chart + KaTeX

previews.seed: two markdown docs in rr-demo:markdown; Write-tab edits persist per content axis
